messages:
vijay: early-morning heads up: restore job for org-delta failed while trying to decrypt the data key. Error: AccessDenied from KMS proxy. Surprisingly, KMS audit shows no Decrypt entries for the key id during the window. Anyone have ideas on a silent-block pattern?
encops-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-210. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-proxy-audit-gap 
keely: We did a scheduled IAM cleanup last night that consolidated service accounts under the new `svc-redwood/*` naming. Could be the mapping layer didn't reconcile new names -> escrow grants.
ryan: Check proxy logs first: `/var/log/kms-proxy/access.log` around 2026-12-12T04:05. If proxy rejects pre-KMS, there won't be any Decrypt audit.
zoe: I pulled the proxy snippet: `2026-12-12T04:05:22Z WARN req=pg87 principal=svc-redwood/uploader mapping_lookup=NO_MATCH -> 403`. So proxy never forwarded. That's why KMS audit is empty.
vijay: Noted. Separate track: infra found evidence that one uploader binary in a legacy fleet still writes unencrypted tmp files under `/var/tmp/rrb-plain-*`. We've got a compliance escalation possibility if those persist after failure. Audit-bot, can you collect file listing from affected host set?
audit-bot: Evidence collection started: collecting `/var/tmp/rrb-plain-*` patterns from hosts in pool `backups-west-1`. Preserving checksums & timestamps.
keely: Immediate remediation: 1) create a short-lived grant for the new SA alias so restores can finish; 2) run a proxy-forward smoke test to confirm KMS Decrypt appears in audit; 3) capture forensic snapshot of any tmpfiles and rotate keys if contamination found.
ryan: On (1): creating time-bound grant now for `svc-redwood/uploader-58` -> CMK `ck-prod-backups` (10m).
encops-bot: Emergency grant created by ryan (expires in 00:10:00).
zoe: After grant applied, I ran: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"key":"ck-prod-backups","ciphertext":"<ct>"}'` and saw `200 OK`. KMS audit now shows Decrypt event: `methodName=google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt`. Restore resumed; 5/6 parts recovered, one hit a CEK fetch timeout during grant propagation but retried and succeeded.
vijay: Good. For evidence: audit-bot please bundle checksums and attach to the incident as an evidence bundle. Compliance wants a timeline and list of hosts with tempfiles.
audit-bot: Evidence bundle created and attached to INC-2026-210. Included host list, file hashes, retention flags.
keely: Post-incident action items (short list): 1) Extend grant-mapping to accept SA canonical UID fallback and prefix aliases; 2) Add a pre-change smoke test in the RBAC->rename playbook that will 1) rename a test SA and 2) assert KMS Decrypt audit appears within 30s; 3) Add proxy instrumentation to emit a structured `kms_proxy_denied` event to SIEM containing principal, key-id, and request_id.
ryan: I'll own the proxy instrumentation (metric + SIEM forwarder). Plan: increment `kms.proxy.denied` metric and emit JSON to audit-stream: `{"event":"kms_proxy_denied","principal":"...","key":"...","req_id":"..."}`. ETA 48h.
zoe: I'll update the RBAC rename checklist and add the smoke test harness. Also will add a lint to the mapping table migration to error on unmatched alias patterns. ETA 72h.
vijay: On the tmpfile vuln: immediate mitigation is to set `TMPDIR=/var/opt/backups/safe_tmp` with 0700 and make uploader call secure-delete on success. Long-term: rework uploader to perform streaming encrypt-and-upload so no full payload ever touches disk. I've opened GH #11999 and added the compliance ticket.
audit-bot: Compliance note: if evidence shows tmpfiles persisted beyond retention window, escalate to legal and SRE for notification plan.
keely: Also proposing alert rule: if a backup-service principal has auth tokens or API calls but zero KMS Decrypt events within a 10-minute sliding window, open a P1 page to oncall. That should catch proxy pre-filters faster than restores failing.
vijay: Agree. Also document in the runbook to collect proxy logs and audit bundle before creating a temp grant to preserve pre-grant state for forensic review.
encops-bot: Post-incident checklist created: @ryan proxy forwarder, @zoe rename-playbook+tests, @keely tmpdir mitigation & GH issue owner. ETA: 72h.
vijay: Thanks team. We'll do a short blameless postmortem and fold lessons into the RBAC & KMS playbooks. If compliance needs the evidence folder earlier ping me. :thumbsup:
